classification_summary.1_DOCUMENTED_FACT: 01-Mar package association; 25-Jun sworn court statement describing repeated DANIEL/JOAN visits, measurements, hotel showing and refurbishment checking; witness photo-folio mapping; authenticated Annex 08-D; recovered HKI 25-Nov-2019 captures.
classification_summary.2_PRIMARY_SOURCE_CORPORATE_REGULATORY_RE: BORME Meeting Point chronology; CNMC BLUESEA/MPS control acquisition. The 25-Jun witness act is separately treated as a primary judicial record, not as a corporate record.
classification_summary.3_CONTEMPORANEOUS_MEDIA_PROFESSIONAL_SEL: 2016 LABRANDA Marieta role; Acosta Matos project pages; Club Sei announcements; 2025 professional activity.
classification_summary.4_CORROBORATED_CONNECTION: Witness-described JOAN + 07–08-May Joan Cruz Nuez identification/investigation + 01-Mar source filename + recurring Meeting Point/LABRANDA–Acosta Matos relationship support a materially corroborated identity/continuity route, without facial recognition or final identity transfer.
classification_summary.5_INVESTIGATIVE_INFERENCE_HYPOTHESIS: Repeated visits, measurements, showing and refurbishment checking justify testing evaluation/project preparation and later commercial continuity; no criminal conclusion.
classification_summary.6_USER_ALLEGATION: Wider alleged causal relationship between pre-title access/project preparation, later material control, commercialisation and adjudication remains separately attributed.
classification_summary.7_UNRESOLVED_REQUIRES_AUTHENTICATION: Final identity/capacity of witness-described JOAN; consent/authority/purpose; original photos/EXIF; certified court-folio ↔ compilation-page reconciliation; native witness-identification chat/date; plans/measurements/project outputs; contracts, first dates and custody.
